raw_text: {"competitors":[],"summary":"The Salesforce filing's competition section describes only generic categories of rivals — vendors of packaged business software, cloud application service providers, AI-native startups and emerging companies, free/bundled software providers, niche industry-specific vendors, productivity and unified communications providers, platform development companies, and would-be customers building internal applications. No specific competitor company is named anywhere in the document. Other named entities (Trailhead, Agentforce, Hyperforce, Dreamforce, Salesforce+, Career Connect) are the company's own products, programs or events rather than competitors."}
